dossier.scp_unleashed.027.title: The Vermin God
dossier.scp_unleashed.027.caption: SCP-027 as first photographed, outside the barn where he was found.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-027 has never stayed in a cell for more than a night. Vermin find their way into any room he is kept in.
Personnel approaching SCP-027 should carry no food and expect to be outnumbered. Vermin near him are hostile.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-027 is a hunched, tired man in a D-Class jumpsuit caked with mud, straw and grime. His hair is matted and his eyes are dull. Flies circle him at all times, and a rat rides on his shoulder.
Wherever he goes, vermin follow. Rats, silverfish, endermites and bats crawl out of the ground around him and go after anyone close.
SCP-027 does not fight. He shuffles toward people, mumbling, and seems to want company.
Food left near him spoils, and crops he passes wilt.

page.title: Addendum 027-1: Recovery
text: SCP-027 was found asleep in a hay loft after rats poured out of a farmer's barn. He apologised to each member of the recovery team.
He has only been met after this file has been opened.

page.title: Addendum 027-2: Interview
page.text: Asked why the vermin follow him, SCP-027 said: "They think I'm theirs. I think they might be right."

message.scp_unleashed.scp027.refuses: SCP-027 does not respond. Something in the swarm pushes back
SCP-027, "The Vermin God": a filthy man in a stained, torn D-Class jumpsuit. He is Keter-class and he is never alone.
He does not occur naturally. Once his archive file has been read, he is found somewhere nearby.
He shuffles slowly toward people. Rats, silverfish, endermites and bats gather around him and go after anyone close.
Food left lying near him spoils, and crops wilt where he walks.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp027.spawn.fail: There is no room for SCP-027 there
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp027.0: A filthy man in a D-Class jumpsuit.
message.scp_unleashed.scp027.line.0: They follow me. They always follow me.
message.scp_unleashed.scp027.line.1: Don't step on the little ones. They remember.
message.scp_unleashed.scp027.line.2: I just want to sit down somewhere quiet.
message.scp_unleashed.scp027.line.3: Every barn I sleep in, they find it too.
message.scp_unleashed.scp027.line.4: I haven't been clean in a long time.
message.scp_unleashed.scp027.line.5: I didn't ask for any of them.
message.scp_unleashed.scp027.line.7: You've got food on you. They can tell.
